origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nNānā§r: 
Ua ʻoi aku ka wehe ʻana o ka hopena o ke kanaka ma mua o ka hapa nui - e hoʻoikaika i waho me ka ʻole o nā pōmaikaʻi a me nā hemahema.
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Alfiq
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Unarmed Bonus§r
§o§2+ Unique Movement§r
§o§6• Carnivore§r
§o§c- Defense§r
§lAlfiq§r he ʻano manu maalea maikaʻi loa o Alfiq§r.Hele pinepine ko lākou mau alanui i ke one mehana.
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Arachnae
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Poison, Crowd Control
+ Wall Climbing§r
§o§6• Carnivore§r
§o§c- Hunger, Armor§r
He hui puana o ka spider a me ke kanaka, me ka hikiwawe o ka hele wāwaemea kaua.
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Banshee
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nNānā nui§r: 
§o§2+ Holo, Kākoʻo, Phasing§r
§o§6• make ole
§o§c- Palekana§r
§o§c- Nā loli nui, heluhelu mua!§r
§lBanshees§r he mau ʻuhane ʻehaʻeha ko lākou uē hiki ke wāwahi i ke aniani a hoʻohuli i nā kānaka i ka pupule.Ma ka moʻolelo, manaʻo pinepine ʻia ko lākou hele ʻana he hōʻailona o ka make.
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: Incubus
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Nether Bonuses
§o§6• Fire-based
§o§c- Poino e ka wai§r
§o§c- Weak in Overworld§r
§lIncubi§r he mau kauwa ino o ka mana pouli.He ikaika lakou ma ko lakou aupuni iho, aka, no keia mea, ua haawi aku lakou i ko lakou uhane, a ua nawaliwali lakou i na kumu maemae.
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nNānā nui§r: 
§o§2+ Mining, Caving§r
§o§6• Pōkole: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- Pilikino ka lā 
- ʻAʻole hiki ke ʻau§r
§lDwarves§r he mea hana, paa, a haaheo.ʻOi aku lākou i ka mining a me ka noho ʻana ma lalo o ka honua, akā hakakā me ka lā.Pōhaku, kaikunāne.
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Ranged Bonuses, Speed§r
§o§6• Stealthy, Vegetarian§r
§o§c- Defense§r
§lWood Elves§r he lāhui naʻauao a lōʻihi ka noho ʻana me ka Honua e noho like me ka honua.He wikiwiki lākou me ka pahi kaua a me ke kakaka a hiki iā lākou ke hoʻopunipuni i ko lākou mau ʻenemi i waena o nā kumulāʻau.
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: Kiekie Elf
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Magic, Unique Abilities§r
§o§c- Physical Damage
- Defence§r
§lHigh Elves§r ua kaulana i ka haaheo, me ka hiki ole ke hoole;E hele ikaika ana nā mea kilokilo elemental ma ko lākou koko, ʻoiai ua nāwaliwali lākou me nā mea kaua.
origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: ʻO Fae
origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Hovering, Magic§r
§o§6• Pōkole: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- Aloha ʻia e Mobs§r
§lFae§r he kupua i ka ululāʻau ululāʻau i hoʻopili ʻia me ka ululāʻau kūlohelohe a pili i ka ululāʻau maoli.
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Goblin
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nNānā nui§r: 
§o§2+ Nā Pākuʻi Kūʻai gula§r
§o§2+ Laki, wikiwiki§r 
§o§6• Liʻiliʻi: 92cm.3'3"§r 
§o§c- Ola, Palekana§r
§lʻO nā goblins§r ke nānā aku nei lākou i ke gula a me ka waiwai a makemake lākou e ʻimi i kahi mea hao wale ma nā wahi a pau a lākou e nānā ai, akā ʻo ko lākou liʻiliʻi liʻiliʻi e haʻalele iā lākou i ke kaua.
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Poison Damage, Immunity§r
§o§2+ Crowd Control§r
§o§c- Hydrophobe 
- Nā nawaliwali kū hoʻokahi§r
§lGorgons§r i hana ʻia me ka poino o ke kanaka, he mea i hoʻopōʻino ʻia me ka lauoho.ʻōlelo ʻia ka helehelena e hoʻoweliweli i ka poʻe i ʻike.
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Moon Elf
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Dagger Damage
+ Dextrous§r
§o§6• Stealthy, Doesn't Sleep§r
§o§c- Defense§r
Pohihihi, ethereal mea no keia ao.Ua kapa ʻia ʻo Moon elves ʻaʻole no ko lākou ʻāina hānau, akā no ka mea wale nō i ʻike ʻia e ka poʻe i hōʻeha ʻia ma mua o ko lākou hopena.
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Ogre
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nNūnai§r: 
§o§2+ Ax Bonuses, Defence §r
§o§6• Nui: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Hunger, Speed §r
§lOgres§r he nui, luʻi o ka Ogresa ʻo ka naʻauao liʻiliʻi i hana ʻia e ko lākou ikaika maka.
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Pixie
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Unique Flight, Odd§r
§o§6• Liʻiliʻi: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Defence, Reputation §r
I manaʻo pinepine ʻia he mau hōʻailona o ka waiwai maikaʻi, akā he mea hoʻopunipuni hoʻi.liʻiliʻi loa.
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nNānā nui§r: 
§o§2+ Ka maloʻo §r
§o§6• Keʻano pāʻani kūʻokoʻa §r
§o§6• make ole §r
§o§c- Palekana, Kaulana 
§o§c- Paʻakikī§r
ʻO nā mea make hapa make i ka maʻi ʻaʻole hiki ke kapa hou ʻia he kanaka, hōʻino ʻia a paʻa i ka ʻeha mau loa ma muli o kahi maʻi kupua ʻē.
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nNānā nui§r: 
§o§2+ Kāhea ʻia §r
§o§2+ Hoʻohana ʻia ʻo Illager 
§o§6• Undead, Complex §r
§o§c- Kaulana
- Nā pilina ola §r
§lRevenants§r he mau ʻuhane pōʻino i make i ka make weliweli a me ka ʻeha, akā ua hoʻi mai i ke ola.ʻO ka hopena, lilo lākou i mea makaʻala i ka hana ʻana i ke ola a me ka make i nā mea ola ʻē aʻe.
origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: Siren
origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Water-Based, Utility §r
§o§6• Weaker on Land§r
§o§c- Vulnerable to Fire§r
§lSirens§r i ʻōlelo ʻia he ʻano Merfolk.He aura hoʻopāpā ko lākou a ʻo ko lākou nani hiki ʻole ke ʻōlelo ʻia ʻo ka hāʻule ʻana o nā luina naʻaupō.
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: ʻO Yeti
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nNānā§r: 
§o§2+ Frost-Based, Tanky§r
§o§6• Nui: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- Heat Sensitive§r
Manoʻano hulu manu, a hiki i nā holoholona huluhulu mānoanoa, hoʻomalu iā lākou mai nā lāʻau hau hau.aka, ua pilikia loa lakou i na hoouka ahi.
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Healing§r 
§o§6• ʻEheu huluhulu§r 
§o§c- Weak to Undead§r
§lValkyrie§r he mau koa ʻēheu wiwo ʻole o ka poʻe e hoʻoholo i ka hopena;Ua ʻōlelo ʻia ua lawe lākou i ka poʻe i make i Valhalla o Odin
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Maʻuʻu
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Loaʻa iā Alfiq nā māuʻuuu ʻoi hiki ke huki ʻia;Hana lākou i nā pōʻino hou me nā wāwae ʻole, a hiki ke piʻi i luna a pili i nā wahi pali (Hiki ke hoʻololi)
Ma kahi kokoke i ka napoʻo ʻana o ka lā a me ka puka ʻana o ka lā, e neʻe ʻo Alfiq a e hoʻouka wikiwiki loa.I kekahi manawa, ua lethargic a lohi iki.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: Inā, i ka pae ʻana, ke nānā pololei nei ʻoe i lalo, mai lawe i ka pōʻino mai ka hāʻule ʻana.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Kaomi ʻākau ma ke kua o ke kamaʻāina ʻoiai e kūlou ana me nā wāwae ʻole no ka manawa e ʻaihue ai i kekahi mau emeralds.A i ʻole e hopu ʻia.Ua ʻōlelo ʻo rumor hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻaihue mai nā mea pāʻani ʻē aʻe.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Pounce
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: Ma hope o ke kūlou pōkole ʻana me ka neʻe ʻole ʻana i luna, hiki i kahi Alfiq ke lele i mua i kahi mamao loa.ʻO ka hahau ʻana i ka ʻenemi i ka wā o ka pounce e hāʻawi i ka pōʻino bonus.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Ua hōʻemi ʻo Alfiq i ka wikiwiki me nā mea hana a hoʻemi i ka pōʻino me nā mea kaua e like me nā pahi kaua a me nā koi.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Makemake ʻo Alfiq e ʻaʻahu wale i nā pale pale māmā no ka maʻalahi o ka neʻe.Hiki ke hoʻohana ʻia nā pale kaua kaumaha me ka ʻole o ka hoʻopaʻi me kahi mea hoʻokalakupua.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Meow
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Pono ʻo Arachnae i ka nui o ka meaʻai e ola ai.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: ʻO ka exoskeleton chitinous o Arachnae he mea paʻakikī ke neʻe inā ʻoi aku ke kaumaha o ke kapa kila ma mua o ka hao.Hiki ke pale ʻia kēia me ka enchantment.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: ʻO nā hulu manu maikaʻi ma nā wāwae o Arachnae e hiki ai iā lākou ke piʻi i nā paia.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: ʻOi aku ka maʻalahi o ka exoskeleton o Arachnae i ka pōʻino.He ʻuʻuku iki ko lākou olakino ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Ua hoʻopili ʻia nā maka ʻewalu o ka Arachnae i ka pōʻeleʻele, a hiki iā lākou ke ʻike maopopo me ka liʻiliʻi o ka mālamalama.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Loaʻa i nā niho o Arachnae ka mea ʻawaʻawa, a he manawa ko kēlā me kēia hoʻouka ʻana e hoʻokomo i ka lāʻau make.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Loaʻa iā Banshees ka hiki ke lilo i mea ʻike ʻole, e neʻe manuahi ana ma ke ʻano o ke kino ʻoiai ʻaʻole hiki ke launa pū me ia.Hoʻohana kēia i ka ikehu nui a ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻāla ʻia i ka wā haʻahaʻa i ka pōloli.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Hexed
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Ua uhi ʻia ʻo Banshees i nā ʻōlelo hōʻino.I kēlā me kēia manawa e paʻi ʻia ai lākou, aia kahi manawa liʻiliʻi e hāʻawi ʻia ka mea hoʻouka i kahi hopena o ka make lohi a me ka ʻeha.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: Loaʻa iā Banshees ka hapalua o ke olakino e loaʻa i ke kanaka ola.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: ʻAʻole hiki ke ʻae ʻia nā metala hoʻomāinoino, e like me ka hao a i ʻole ke kālā.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: ʻAʻole hoʻihoʻi ʻo Banshees i ka pōloli mai ka meaʻai - hoʻihoʻi wale ʻia ko lākou ikehu e ka mālamalama o ka mahina, akā naʻe, ʻaʻole hiki iā lākou ke pōloli.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: ʻO nā ʻuā a Banshee e ʻōlelo mua i ka make.Hiki iā lākou ke hoʻokuʻu i kahi uwē kani, hoʻihoʻi i hope i nā mea kokoke a kāhea i kahi pōʻai pale liʻiliʻi.ʻO nā pahuhopu i pā pololei ʻia e ka uē ʻana e hoʻokaʻawale ʻia
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: Hoʻonui ʻoe i ka pōʻino ke hoʻohana ʻoe i kahi mea kaua i hōʻino ʻia.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Ke pale nei ʻoe i nā pōʻino hou aʻe no kēlā me kēia ʻāpana o nā mea kaua i hōʻino ʻia.
ʻAʻole maʻaʻole ka makemake koko o kahi incubus.Inā ʻaʻole ia he ʻiʻo o ka holoholona, ​​he mea ʻole ia.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: ʻOi aku ka mana o Incubi me nā mea kilokilo ahi a pau, a hiki ke hoʻokuʻu i ka lapalapa o ka lapalapa ma ka makemake.Nā unahi me ka Mana Spell ahi.
Ua like ke ahi me ka home - ʻaʻole ia e hoʻopōʻino iā Incubi a māʻona iā lākou.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Hoʻopau ka wai i ka Incubi, e hoʻopōʻino iā lākou ma ka pili.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Lawe ʻo Incubi i nā pōʻino hou mai Smite a hoʻihoʻi i nā hopena mai ka ho'ōla a me ka hōʻeha.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: ʻAʻole maʻa ʻo Incubi i nā ana kahi e ʻā ai ka lā a nāwaliwali i laila, akā ʻoi aku ka ikaika ma Nether.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: Hiki i kahi incubus ke hoʻololi i kekahi o ko lākou ola ola no ka mana maka no ka manawa pōkole.Hoʻomaka ʻia me ke kī ʻo Primary Active.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: E puhi ka lā pololei i nā maka dwarven, e makapō iā lākou no kekahi manawa.Hiki ke pale ʻia me ka enchantment a i ʻole ka mahiole gula.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: Paʻapū
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: He kaumaha loa nā dwarves no ko lākou nui;poho koke lakou i ka wai.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Hiki i nā dwarves ke ʻeli pōhaku me ka ʻole o ka pickaxe, a ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o kaʻu mea ma mua o nā mea ʻē aʻe.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: He pōkole wale nā ​​dwarves i hiki ke komo i loko o kahi tunnel 1 mika kiʻekiʻe (a ʻaneʻane like me ka laulā).
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Hiki i nā dwarves ke nānā pono i ka ʻike me ka ʻole o ke kumu kukui.
Kaulana ʻo Dwarves i kā lākou mau mea inu ikaika e hoʻokuʻu ʻelua i ka nui o kekahi.Hoʻoikaika e lawe i kahi swig a hoʻihoʻi piha i ke olakino.
ʻAʻohe loli o ke kanaka mai ka pāʻani kumu.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Hoʻopau ʻo Wood Elves i ko lākou ola holoʻokoʻa me nā kakaka - ʻoi aku ka make o kā lākou mau pua.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: ʻOiai i loko o nā kumu lāʻau kiʻekiʻe a i ʻole nā lau, hiki i nā elves lāʻau ke kūlou i mea e ʻike ai i ka pō a lilo i mea ʻike ʻole ʻia e nā poʻe ʻino kokoke.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Hiki iā Wood Elves ke hahai i ka ʻenemi no ka manawa pōkole ma hope o ka hōʻino ʻana iā lākou, ʻoiai ʻaʻole lākou i ʻike ʻia.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: Ma hope o ka hoʻouka ʻana i ke kakaka no kekahi mau kekona, e hoʻokuʻu i kahi pua me ka wikiwiki a me ka pololei e lele hou a ʻoi aku ka ʻoiaʻiʻo, a hou aku i nā ʻenemi 2.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: He liʻiliʻi ke olakino ʻo Wood Elves a ua lohi ʻia ma ke kāʻei ʻana i nā mea kaua kaumaha (Hiki ke pale ʻia kēia me kahi enchant).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Noho nā elves lāʻau i ka nahele - ʻAʻole hiki iā lākou ke ʻeli i ka ʻiʻo.
ʻOi aku ka lōʻihi o ka lāʻau elves ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
ʻAʻole ikaika nā elves lāʻau, akā wikiwiki lākou.Hoʻemi iki kāu mau hoʻouka ʻana akā ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Hoʻohihi
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: ʻO Fae ka mea hoʻohiwahiwa maoli.E alualu aku ka poʻe ʻino iā lākou mai kahi mamao aku ma mua o nā mea ʻē aʻe.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: He pōkole ʻo Fae, ʻaʻole i ʻoi aku ka lōʻihi ma mua o ka goblin maʻamau.
Ka hao a me ke kala i ka mana fae.He mea hiki ole ia lakou ke komo.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: ʻO Fae nā mea ʻēheu māmā a hiki ke lana ma ka lewa.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Kaila ikaika ola ikehu no ka manawa pokole.ʻOiai e hana ana, e hohola i nā ʻanoʻano ma luna o ka ʻāina mahiʻai a me ka ho'ōla pulse a me ka hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻana i ka ikehu i nā hoa pili kokoke.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: E hoʻolaha i ka huʻi o ka ikehu ola, e hoʻomomona koke i nā mea kanu ma kahi a puni ʻoe.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: ʻOiai ʻoe i loko o ka puliki o ka nahele, ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o kou mau ʻeha.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: Ua paʻa ʻoe i ke ʻano, hāʻawi iā ʻoe i ka pale ʻana i ka lāʻau make a me ka nausea, a me ke kūʻē ʻana i nā hoʻouka kupua.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: ʻO Fae nā mea maʻalahi me ka liʻiliʻi o ke olakino ma mua o ke kanaka.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: He poʻe akamai ʻo Goblins, a ʻike i kahi e loaʻa ai ka waiwai hao kakaʻikahi a nā poʻe ʻē aʻe e poina.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: Nawaliwali
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Ma muli o ko lākou kino liʻiliʻi, ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o ke olakino o nā goblins a ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi o ka pōʻino.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: Pilikino
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: He pilina koʻikoʻi ko Goblins me ka waiwai - loaʻa iā lākou nā bonus hou i ka wā e hoʻohana ai a hoʻohana paha i nā mea gula.
ʻOi aku ka lōʻihi o ke gula ma nā lima o ke goblin ma mua o ka hapa nui o ka poʻe mālama ʻole me ia.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: ʻOliʻiliʻi
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: ʻOiai pōkole, wikiwiki loa nā goblins, hiki iā lākou ke holo i mua o nā ʻenemi ikaika loa ma mua o ka hakakā ʻana.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: He pōkole loa nā goblins, ma lalo o ka hapalua o ke kiʻekiʻe o ke kanaka.
ʻAʻole hiki i nā Gorgons ke ʻae i ka maʻemaʻe o ka wai a lawe i ka pōʻino mai ia mea.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā Gorgons e noho paʻa i nā ana ʻeleʻele a me nā hale paʻahao kahiko.Ma waho i ke ao, e hoʻomāʻewaʻewa lākou a hiki i ka pō.Hiki ke hōʻole ʻia ma ke komo ʻana i ka mahiole.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: He nāwaliwali nā Gorgons i ka maʻemaʻe o ke kālā - ʻaʻole hiki iā lākou ke kū i ka ʻaʻahu a lawe i ka pōʻino i ka wā e hoʻohana ai.(Ua helu ʻia ka hao he kālā)
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: E ʻike i nā maka o nā poʻe lehulehu e kū pono ana iā ʻoe, e hoʻohuli iā lākou i pōhaku pōkole.ʻAʻole hana ma luna o nā luna.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: ʻAʻole ʻae ʻia nā Gorgons i ka lāʻau ʻawaʻawa, a loaʻa iā lākou ka manawa e hoʻokahe i ko lākou koko ʻawaʻawa i nā ʻenemi kokoke i ka wā e pā ai, e ʻona ai iā lākou.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Hoʻonui nui ʻo Gorgons i ka pōʻino ma ke olakino haʻahaʻa.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: Hoʻolohi ʻia nā Elves kiʻekiʻe ma ke komo ʻana i nā mea kaua koʻikoʻi (Hiki ke pale ʻia kēia me kahi enchant), a ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o ke olakino.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: Ma ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i nā mea like ʻole, hiki i nā elves kiʻekiʻe ke hoʻokahe i ka ikehu o ka mea e hoʻokuʻu i nā mea kilokilo.E kau ma luna o kēlā me kēia pahu e ʻike i nā kikoʻī.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: ʻAʻole i kūkulu ʻia kahi High Elf no ka hakakā lima lima.Ua ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi o ka pōʻino kino, a ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o ke olakino.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: ʻO nā Elves kiʻekiʻe he mana a akamai hoʻi i ka ikehu arcane - hana lākou i nā pōʻino kilokilo ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o nā pōʻino kilokilo ma mua o nā lāhui ʻē aʻe.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_rpgm: ʻOi aku ka mana o High Elves ma mua o nā lāhui ʻē aʻe, a hiki iā ia ke hoʻokahe i ka mana o ko lākou poʻe kahiko e hoʻohou i ka mana.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: ʻOi aku ka mana o High Elves ma mua o nā lāhui ʻē aʻe, a hiki iā ia ke hoʻokahe i ka mana o ko lākou poʻe kahiko e hoʻohou i ka mana.
ʻOi aku ka mana o High Elves ma mua o nā lāhui ʻē aʻe, a hiki iā ia ke hoʻokahe i ka mana o ko lākou poʻe kahiko e hoʻohou i ka mana.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: ʻOi aku ka mana o High Elves ma mua o nā lāhui ʻē aʻe, a hiki iā ia ke hoʻokahe i ka mana o ko lākou poʻe kahiko e hoʻohou i ka mana.
ʻO nā Elves kiʻekiʻe he lohi a ʻoi aku ka lōʻihi ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.crazed.de: E hoʻāʻo e like me kā lākou e hiki ai, ʻaʻole hiki i ka Moon Elves ke hiamoe i ka honua.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: I ka pōʻeleʻele, hiki i ka Moon Elves ke huli i ka ʻike ʻole ʻia e ka hoʻoheheʻe ʻana, a neʻe i kahi mamao i ka wā e ʻaihue ʻia.I ka hoʻouka kaua ʻana mai ka stealth, ʻo kā lākou hoʻouka kaua mua e hana i ka pōʻino bonus a hoʻopau i ka ʻike ʻole.Hāʻawi kēia i ka pōʻino hou inā e hoʻohana ana i kahi pahi.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Hoʻolohi ʻia ʻo Moon Elves ma ke komo ʻana i nā mea kaua kaumaha.Hiki ke pale ʻia kēia me ka enchantment.
He lahilahi a translucent iki ka mahina elves, a he ʻano uliuli ko lākou ʻili.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Ua hōʻemi ʻo Moon Elves i ke olakino a lawe i ka pōʻino kino.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: ʻOi aku ka maikaʻi o ka Moon Elves i ka hoʻohana ʻana i kahi māmā a maʻalahi hoʻi e hūnā i nā mea kaua.Hoʻonui lākou i nā pōʻino me nā pahi a me nā pahi.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: Me kā lākou hoʻololi wikiwiki, loaʻa iā Moon Elves kahi manawa liʻiliʻi e pale aku i kekahi hoʻouka kaua.
Ua like ke kiʻekiʻe o Moon Elves me ko lākou mau ʻohana mamao o ka nahele, ʻoi aku ko lākou lōʻihi ma mua o ke kanaka.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: Nui nā ʻOgres, ʻaʻole hiki ke komo ma nā puka a i ʻole i nā hale liʻiliʻi.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: Manaʻo liʻiliʻi ʻo Ogres i ka mea a lākou e ʻai ai.ʻO ka meaʻai ka meaʻai.ʻAʻole lākou i ʻike i ka lāʻau make a me ka pōloli.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.name: Ravenous
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.desc: ʻAʻole piha ʻo Ogres;pono lākou e ʻai kokoke i nā manawa a pau e māʻona ai.'
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.name: Pehemo
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.descr: ʻIke pololei nā koʻi i ka lima o ka Ogre;ʻO kēia hōʻoluʻolu e hiki ai iā lākou ke koli me ka ikaika nui.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: Ua ʻike ʻia ʻo Ogres e lele lele ʻole i loko o ka huhū makapō, kahi hiki iā lākou ke hehi koke i ka pūʻulu o nā ʻenemi akā hiki ʻole ke ʻike i nā mea e hana nei a puni lākou.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: Molowa
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: ʻOi aku ka lohi o Ogres ma mua o ka hapa nui, e mālama i kekahi o ko lākou ikaika ʻoiai ko lākou nui nui.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: Kākoʻo
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: ʻO ka ʻili mānoanoa o Ogres a me nā iwi paʻa e hiki ai iā lākou ke hoʻopaʻa i nā pahu he nui aʻe ma mua o nā mea ʻē aʻe.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: ʻAʻole hiki i nā Pixies ke komo i nā pale umauma ʻoi aku ka nui ma mua o ka ʻili, a ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻohana i nā ʻēheu ʻē aʻe e lele ʻokoʻa.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: Maʻalahi nā pixies, ʻaʻole hiki iā lākou ke lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: Ma ka lepo
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Hiki i nā Pixes ke lele a hoʻoulu iā lākou iho i mua a i luna.
E heluhelu i nā pahu e pili ana i kēia mana no nā ʻōlelo aʻoaʻo e pili ana i ka lele.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: Pōkole
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: Hiki iā ʻoe ke noho ma luna o ke poʻo o kekahi mea pāʻani ma ke kaomi ʻākau iā lākou me nā lima ʻole.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: ʻOiai hiki ke pilikia nā pixies, pili pū lākou me ka laki maikaʻi.I ka hana ʻana, e loaʻa iā lākou kekahi mea waiwai mai ka pōhaku maʻemaʻe.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: ʻO nā pixies kekahi o nā mea liʻiliʻi loa e holoholo i ka ʻāina, ʻaʻole hiki ke hiki i ke kuli o ke kanaka.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: Puu
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: ʻO ka liʻiliʻi e like me lākou, he mea weliweli ka wai i nā pixies.Hoʻopilikia ia i ko lākou neʻe ʻana a hoʻopilikia i ko lākou hiki ke lele.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: Ua ʻike nā kamaʻāina i nā pixies ma nā moʻolelo o ka pilikia a lākou e hana ai, a hōʻole lākou e kālepa me lākou.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: He mea weliweli ka Plagued.E hōʻole nā ​​kamaʻāina e kālepa me lākou no ka makaʻu.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: Hoʻopili ka mea kilokilo weliweli i ka mea i pepehi ʻia, a hoʻopau mālie i ke ola o kekahi mea e noho kokoke ana.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: ʻAʻole hiki i ka Plagued ke hiamoe, no ko lākou ʻeha pau ʻole.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: ʻOiai ʻaʻole i pau ka ʻeha nui, he nui wale nō ka ʻiʻo e hiki ke make.ʻAʻole hiki i nā mea lawe i ka lāʻau make a maloʻo.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: Hoʻokahi manawa i kēlā me kēia 5 mau minuke, ma hope o ka make, mālama ikaika ʻia ka Plagued e hoʻolōʻihi i ko lākou ʻeha.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: I kēlā me kēia manawa āu e paʻi ai, aia kahi manawa e hoʻolaha ai i ka maʻi.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: Ua uhi ʻia ka Plagued i nā ʻili a me nā ʻeha ma ka ʻili, palupalu a ʻeha ke hoʻopā.ʻAʻole hiki i kāna poʻe i hoʻopilikia ke komo i ka pale kaua no ka ʻeha i hana ʻia.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: ʻO kēia maʻi e hoʻokahe i ka ʻuhane, ka hopena o ke olakino a me ka wikiwiki.
power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: I loko o ka wai, hiki i nā sirens ke hanu a hana maʻamau, ʻike maopopo, a ʻauʻau lākou me ka wikiwiki.
power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: ʻAʻole hui pū nā kani a me ke ahi.ʻO ka pili ʻana me ka lapalapa e hopena i ka make koke.
power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o ka hoʻōla hou ʻana o nā kino, akā i ka wā i hoʻopiha piha ʻia.
power.medievalorigins.siren.out_of_your_: ʻOiai ma ka ʻāina, hiki i nā Sirens ke ho'ōla a hoʻōla hou paha me ka hoʻohana ʻana i nā lāʻau.
power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Hoʻoikaika e hoʻopau i nā ʻenemi ma kahi ākea, e pale iā lākou mai ka hoʻopōʻino iā ʻoe no ka manawa pōkole.ʻAʻole hana ma luna o nā luna a me nā mea pāʻani.
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.name: Hoopio
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.descr: E kaomi i ke kī lua e loaʻa ai ka lokomaikaʻi me ke kamaʻāina a loaʻa i nā kālepa maikaʻi aʻe mai iā lākou.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Hiki i nā Yetis ke hōʻino i ke ahi ma muli o ko lākou ʻano hoʻoilo.
Hiki iā Yeti ke hoʻokomo i nā ʻenemi kokoke i ka hau ma ke kauoha.ʻAʻole hana ma lalo a ma luna o nā luna.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.from_whence_y: I loko o nā biomes hau, ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o ka neʻe ʻana a hōʻole i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.frosty_breath: Hoʻolohi ka hanu hau o ka yeti i nā hoa paio e hoʻokokoke aku iā lākou.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.thick_fur.des: I nā wao nahele, lilo ka hulu mānoanoa i mea hōʻino - hoʻolohi ia i ka neʻe ʻana o Yetis a hōʻemi i ke olakino
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.name: Titanic
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.descr: ʻOi aku ka maikaʻi o ka Yetis ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.unstoppable.d: ʻAʻole pale ʻo Yetis i ka hopena lohi.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.winter_body.d: ʻOi aku ka lōʻihi o Yetis ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau, a ʻoi aku ka laulā.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.command_s: E kauoha i kāu kaua kaua i make (ʻaʻole nā lio) e hahai, noho, a teleport paha iā ʻoe.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.black_thu: ʻAʻole hiki i ka Revenant ke ʻohi i nā mea kanu;mae lakou i ko lakou hoopa make ana.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.disturbed: ʻO ka hoʻāʻo ʻana i ka mea i pāpā ʻia e hoʻopololei i ka noʻonoʻo.ʻAʻole hiki i nā Revenants ke hiamoe, makaʻu loa e moeʻuhane i ka mea a lākou e makemake ai ʻaʻole lākou i ʻike.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: Ma ka makemake, hiki i kahi revenant ke hoʻāla i kahi pōʻai o nā iwi inert, e hana ana i pale pale no ka manawa pōkole e pale aku iā lākou mai ka pōʻino a hōʻino i nā ʻenemi kokoke.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unwithera: ʻAʻole maloʻo nā Revenants, a, e like me ka undead, lawe lākou i nā pōʻino hou mai ka hahau ʻana, loaʻa nā hopena hoʻohuli mai ka hōʻeha ʻana a me nā hopena hoʻōla, a pale ʻole i nā mea make a me nā hopena hou.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.putrid_co:
Ma o ka hana ʻino ʻole o ka ʻai ʻana i ka ʻiʻo a i ʻole nā iwi o ka poʻe i make ʻole, hiki i kahi revenant ke hoʻoikaika i kā lākou kāhea ʻana o ia ʻano like.
No nā mea hakakā, e hoʻolōʻihi i ko lākou lōʻihi, e hoʻomau iā lākou i ka mana kiʻekiʻe.No nā lio undead, hoʻonui i ko lākou mau ʻano ma ka mana kiʻekiʻe.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.skeleton_: Hiki i nā Revenants ke hana hou i nā mea ola o ka pō i hoʻololi ʻia e hana i kā lākou kauoha ponoʻī.He mau holoholona kēia, e hahai a teleport, a hiki ke hoʻolako ʻia me nā mea kaua a i ʻole nā ​​​​mea kaua.ʻAʻole hiki i nā zombies ke hoʻohana i nā kakaka.E kau i nā ʻōkuhi no nā kikoʻī.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.poor_repu: E hōʻole nā ​​kamaʻāina i ke kālepa ʻana me nā revenants a e hoʻouka ʻia nā golem hao iā lākou i ka ʻike.Eia nō naʻe, ʻae ʻia lākou (tenuously) e Pillagers.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon.de: I ka wā e paʻi ai, kūkulu mālie nā revenants i kahi mana e hiki ai iā lākou ke hoʻopau i ke ola mai ko lākou mau ʻenemi.Hoʻopilikia kēia i nā mea ola a pau no ka maikaʻi a i ʻole ka hewa, koe wale nō ka poʻe i kiʻi ʻia i make.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unguarded: ʻO ka nānā ʻana ma luna o ke aupuni ʻuhane e waiho i nā revenants e wehe hou aku i ka hoʻouka ʻana i ke aupuni kino.ʻO ka hapa nui o nā poʻe pōʻino e hoʻopilikia hou iā lākou.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.wings.des: He mau ʻēheu hulu keʻokeʻo nui ʻo Valkyrie, a hiki ke lele manuahi.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.intervent:
E lele i luna i ka lewa a i ʻole e lele i mua inā e lele ana, e loaʻa ai ka palekana hāʻule a hiki i ka pae ʻana.

Ma ka pae ʻana a i ʻole ma hope o 10 kekona, e hahau i ka wahi me ka ikaika hemolele, e hoʻomaʻemaʻe i nā hopena maikaʻi ʻole mai nā hoa pili kokoke a hoʻōla iā lākou, a hoʻihoʻi i hope ʻole.Hoʻōla i nā unahi me ka mana hoʻōla.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.divine_sm: I kēlā me kēia hoʻouka kaua ʻekolu, e hahau i nā ʻenemi kokoke.E hōʻino i nā unahi me ka mana hoʻōla.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.corruptio: Hoʻonāwaliwali a hoʻolohi ka poʻe undead kokoke iā ʻoe, a ʻoi aku ka nui o kā lākou hoʻouka ʻana iā ʻoe.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.vanquishe: Ma ka pepehi ʻana i ka lehulehu undead, e hoʻāla i ka §nDivine Smite§r§r§r a e hoʻemi iki i ka hopena o ka §nCorruption§r no kēlā me kēia pepehi ʻia.E lilo i ka hapalua o nā puʻu i ka make.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.heavenly_: Loaʻa iā Valkyrie ka mana hoʻōla a ʻoi aku ka ikaika me ka ihe a i ʻole nā mea kaua e like me ka ihe.
enchantment.medievalorigins.featherweigh: Hiki ke hoʻohana ʻia kēia mea hoʻokalakupua i nā mea kaua koʻikoʻi e pale ai i ka hoʻolohi ʻana iā Arachnae, Elves, Alfiq, a i ʻole nā ​​mea ʻēheu.
enchantment.medievalorigins.mirroring.de: Me kēia hana hoʻokalakupua i hoʻohana ʻia i nā mahiole, ʻaʻole hiki i nā mea pāʻani ke ʻike i ka maka o Gorgon a ʻike maʻamau nā Dwarves i ke ao.
entity.medievalorigins.summon_wither_ske: Ka Iwi Melo o ka Mea Summoner

badges.medievalorigins.revenant.command: E kaomi i ka %s no ke kaʻapuni ma waena o ke kauoha ʻana i kāu kiʻi e noho, hahai, a teleport paha iā ʻoe.

badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.glacial_: §bGlacial Step:§r E paʻa i kahi poloka hau e hoʻopololei i ka entropy o nā molekele wai, e ʻae iā ʻoe e hele me he mea lā iā Frost Walker.
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.extrusiv: §4Ka neʻe ʻana i waho:§r E paʻa i ka obsidian e hoʻokahe i ke kahe o ka wela a hele manuahi ma luna o ka pele ʻā
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.instant_: §eLaau koke:§r E kaomi akau i ke kamaaina me ka opala gula e hookahe pololei i kona ikehu hoola me ka pono ole e hoonawaliwali ia lakou.
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.void_war: §5Void Warp:§r E kaomi i ka %s oiai e paʻa ana i ka momi hope e haehae i ka lole o ka ʻoiaʻiʻo a teleport pono iā ʻoe iho ma kahi āu e nānā nei, a hiki i 50 mau poloka ka mamao.
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.blazenbr: §cBlazenbreath:§r E kaomi i ka %s oiai e paa ana ka lanahu ma kela lima keia lima no ka pana ana i ka pahu ahi nawaliwali.E hoʻopaʻa i ka pauka ahi e pana aku i kahi pahu ahi liʻiliʻi.Nā unahi me ka Mana Spell ahi.
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbrea: §dEbonbreath:§r E kaomi i ka %s oiai e paa ana i ka hanu o ka omole dragon ma kela lima keia lima e pana aku i ke ahi o ke ahi kupua ikaika.Nā unahi me ke ahi a me ka mana Spell Arcane.
badges.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon: E pā i kahi mea ola e hoʻokahe i kona ikaika ola.ʻO nā unahi pōʻino me ka waiwai i hōʻiliʻili ʻia a me ka Soul Spell Power.
